title: Keto-friendly Smoky Greek Falafel Bowl
description: A smoky, tender, and satisfying Greek dish featuring falafel, a sweet and tangy glaze, and keto-friendly ingredients. Serve in a beautiful lacquerware bowl for a special treat.

ingredients.name: Ground chicken breast
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a lean cut for keto-friendliness

ingredients.name: Greek yogurt
ingredients.notes: Thick and creamy, perfect for the glaze

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.notes: A touch of sweetness for balance

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the ground chicken breast, canned chickpeas, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Place the patties on the prepared baking sheet, leaving about 1 inch of space between each.
Bake the falafel for 18-20 minutes, or until they are cooked through and lightly browned on the outside.
While the falafel are baking, prepare the glaze by whisking together the Greek yogurt, lemon juice, and honey in a small bowl.
Once the falafel are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes. Then, brush the glaze over the top of each patty.
Transfer the falafel to a lacquerware bowl and garnish with chopped parsley. Serve immediately and enjoy!
Optional: Serve with a side of keto-friendly tzatziki sauce or a simple green salad.
